instruction.text: Pete jumped into a pool from a height of 3.8 metres. From what height did Pete jump, rounded to the nearest whole number?
Amanda’s dog is 7.6 years old. How old is Amanda’s dog, rounded to the nearest whole number?
Sarah ran 10.4 kilometres. How far did she run, rounded to the nearest whole number?
The weight of this ball is 3 kilograms, rounded to the nearest whole number. What is the lightest possible weight of the ball?

atoms.b: The lowest weight the ball can be is <mat><gap>2.5</gap></mat> kilograms.
